gaps.text: In-line measurement of Turbidity / optical state with turbidity sensor
In-line measurement of Process temperature with temperature sensor

Combining several spectroscopy methods (data fusion) (Data fusion merges synchronized NIR transflection and MIR ATR spectra into an augmented matrix with block autoscaling so neither spectral method dominates. Probes must sample the same stream point simultaneously, with spectral acquisitions normalized to a common time step. Separate calibration and drift diagnostics must be maintained for each instrument block, and the fused model must demonstrate superior prediction accuracy over the best single method on held-out runs.)
Protein concentration range and accuracy targets for this specific whey stream

items.finding: The temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary.
items.how_it_applies: Temperature variations can strongly affect water-dominated spectra such as dairy whey, indicating that process temperature should be monitored or controlled to maintain model stability.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: This finding refers to laboratory or specific optical setups rather than an in-line dairy whey stream, so the exact temperature coefficient must be determined empirically for the chosen probe.
